name: What is the best type of flooring to install in a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What is the best type of flooring to install in a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Porcelain and ceramic tile remain the most popular, water-resistant choices for bathroom floors, while luxury vinyl plank (LVP) offers a softer, budget-friendly alternative. Natural stone, such as marble, provides high-end appeal but requires periodic sealing to resist moisture and staining. When choosing, weigh slip resistance, subfloor load capacity, and routine upkeep. For bathrooms that see daily family use, glazed porcelain tile provides maximum moisture defense and scratch resistance without demanding the continuous maintenance that real marble requires.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain tile is typically the best bathroom flooring for durability and water resistance. Luxury vinyl plank and natural stone like marble are also common choices.
